appraisal_events.evidence: L'atelier d'Elstir m'apparut comme le laboratoire d'une sorte de nouvelle création du monde... c'est en leur ôtant leur nom, ou en leur en donnant un autre qu'Elstir les recréait.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator elevates Elstir by describing his studio and painting practice in terms of a demiurgic re-creation of the world, presenting his art as revealing poetic truths ordinary perception and language obscure.

status_effects.explanation: Elstir's art is presented with sustained, narrator-endorsed admiration as a near-godlike act of creative renaming, clearly raising his local standing as an artist.
